title: Sans-Souci Palace
geometryBasis: Surviving mapped palace way 183852572 fixes a roughly 55 m by 21 m principal footprint and projection. The wider historic stair geometry is estimated.
sectionBasis: Clarke and Küstner depict the monumental paired stairs, columned central pavilion, raised roofs and lower side wings. Written surveys confirm the Doric front and curved rear pediment.
limitations: Circa 1819 exterior is reconstructed from prints and surviving walls. Individual bay details, elevation, roof structure, finishes and stair grades are estimates.
The original ground samples are preserved. Historic landscaping, annexes, the chapel, interiors and furnishings are outside the main residence model. The stair and footing grade are approximate.
